summary: Byte-string copy from this to a2. Guards on a non-null destination, then computes the source-to-destination byte displacement v3 = a2 - this and forward-copies bytes one at a time (result[v3] = *result) until a zero terminator byte is read, copying the terminator as well. Returns the source pointer advanced past the copied terminator. The prelabel getter template is contradicted by the raw source: this is a copy routine, not a field getter.

local_names.this: source buffer of a NUL-terminated byte string
local_names.a2: destination buffer; the copy is skipped entirely when a2 is null
local_names.v3: constant byte displacement from the source to the destination (a2 - this)
local_names.v4: current source byte, also the loop terminator test
local_names.result: advancing source pointer; returned after the copied terminator

operations.description: The copy body only runs when the destination a2 is non-null; a null destination returns this immediately
Compute the constant byte displacement v3 = a2 - this so each source byte at result is written to result[v3] (the mirrored destination position)
Forward byte loop: read v4 = *result, write result[v3] = v4, advance result, and repeat until the copied byte v4 is zero (the terminator is copied too, so the loop stops on the first zero byte)
Return the source pointer result, which points one byte past the copied terminator
Invoked by AnimationPlaybackSequence (0044ACB0), sub_4CEF30 (004CEF30) and VehicleGraphicsSceneLoader (004DFCE0), which supply the destination buffer

unresolved: The prelabel template classified this as a getter returning field this+0, which the raw source contradicts; this+0 is actually the source string buffer consumed by the copy
There is no length bound on the copy, so a source buffer without a terminator byte within reachable memory would overrun; the intended buffer sizes are not documented in the packet
